tactical.title: Tactical Stress Board
tactical.why_it_matters: Tactical stress signals identify short-horizon fragility before it registers in broader macro indicators.

sections.question: Where is near-term stress concentrating across credit, vol, and liquidity?
sections.answer: HY credit spreads are widening at a pace above the 80th percentile of 30-day moves while VIX remains below 20 — a historically brief divergence that typically resolves with either spread compression or a vol spike.
sections.why: Credit-vol divergences of this magnitude have resolved within 10 trading days in 80% of historical occurrences; the direction of resolution determines tactical allocation implications.
sections.risk: If VIX catches up to credit spreads, a rapid volatility repricing could amplify forced selling.
sections.support: Financial conditions index remains accommodative, limiting systemic amplification risk.
sections.caveat: Only HY OAS is active; IG OAS and loan spreads are candidate-only, limiting spread composite confidence.
